Definition: One row per AI authorization; code prospective PCCP modifications explicitly described in FDA material.
Code_when: Select every supported category once; separate numbers with semicolons (1;4). Record uncertain codes and reasons separately; retain supported codes.
Do_not_code_when: Exclude current-submission changes, general features and validation activities. Do not infer implementation consequences. Blank means unfinished or unresolved, not no modifications.

Definition: Changes to learned models or deterministic processing and decision rules.
Code_when: Explicit training/retraining, parameters, architecture, preprocessing, postprocessing, thresholds or rules change; also code alongside other categories when explicit.
Do_not_code_when: Do not assume retraining from new compatibility or clinical functions. Libraries/infrastructure alone: 5.

Definition: Changes to supported patient ages or clinical conditions.
Code_when: Supported population or labeled population limitations change, even without formal Indications for Use changes.
Do_not_code_when: More training examples or improved generalizability alone.

Definition: Addition or removal of clinical tasks, measurements, findings or guidance.
Code_when: The clinical task or delivered clinical information changes.
Do_not_code_when: New processing within the same task alone: 1. A new function does not automatically imply 1.

Definition: Changes to admitted input information, acquisition conditions, external equipment or connected systems.
Code_when: New/changed inputs, scanners, sensors, wearables or data connections are supported.
Do_not_code_when: Generic feature engineering alone. Changes to the device's own physical parts: 8; internal software infrastructure: 5.

Definition: Changes to libraries, dependencies, execution environment or technical infrastructure.
Code_when: A specific infrastructure change is described.
Do_not_code_when: Faster processing as a goal alone. Compatibility with additional external systems: 4.

Definition: Changes to presentation or user interaction.
Code_when: Displays, navigation, language, dashboards, interaction methods or user-configurable controls change.

Definition: Substantive changes to labeled information as a modification target.
Code_when: Instructions, limitations, breakpoints or other labeling are themselves changed under the PCCP.
Do_not_code_when: Routine manuals/release notes documenting other changes; segmentation or training labels.

Definition: Changes to physical parts, modules or accessories of the device.
Code_when: A physical device-component change is described.
Do_not_code_when: Additional external equipment compatibility: 4. Merely naming a module leaves this category unresolved.

Definition: Changes to cleaning methods, agents or procedures.
Code_when: The PCCP explicitly permits a cleaning change.
Do_not_code_when: Unspecified maintenance or physical hardware changes alone.
